title: Septic Pumping Cost Estimator
intro: Three questions gives you a real number. No email required, no phone call, no "contact us for a quote".

inputs.label: How big is your tank?
inputs.help: If you do not know, choose Not sure — most Davidson County homes are 1,000 gallons, and mobile homes are usually smaller.

inputs.label: Can you see the tank lids?
inputs.help: This is the single largest swing factor in what a pump-out costs. Hand-digging a buried lid adds real time on site.

options.label: Yes — risers bring them to ground level
Yes — lids are at or near the surface
No — they are buried and need digging
I have no idea where the tank is

inputs.label: When was it last pumped?
inputs.help: Long gaps let sludge compact, which can turn a routine pump-out into a tank cleaning.

options.label: Over 10 years ago, or never / no records

steps: Start from the base rate for your tank capacity — bigger tanks hold more and take longer to pump.
Add for access. A lid at grade costs nothing extra; a buried lid means hand-digging, which national cost data puts at $50–$200.
Add for overdue intervals, where compacted sludge may require cleaning rather than straightforward pumping.
The range shown is roughly ±12% around that figure, which is the honest spread before we have seen your tank.

output.headline: Your likely cost
output.disclaimer: This is an estimate built from published Tennessee and Davidson County price data, not a quote. Tennessee pumping runs $275–$525; Davidson County homeowner-reported figures span $199–$796. What we find when the tank is open — a corroded baffle, a missing effluent filter, compacted sludge — can change it, and we tell you before doing the work, not after.

comparisons.label: Drain field replacement in Tennessee
comparisons.note: What routine pumping is protecting. Middle Tennessee fields skew large because the soils drain slowly, so replacement here sits above national averages.

comparisons.label: Drain field repair, Nashville area
comparisons.note: Where a field is salvageable. Still many times the cost of the pump-out that would have prevented it.

comparisons.label: Baffle replacement
comparisons.note: Found during a routine pump-out. The repair that stops solids reaching the field.

comparisons.label: Risers, fitted once
comparisons.note: Removes the buried-lid surcharge from every future service. Usually pays for itself in two or three visits.

leadCapture.body: An estimate is a starting point. Tell us the property and we will give you a firm price before we come out.
